description: REMix researchers publish the pilot implementation of an energy-system model instance for the Destination Earth use case. Its native description identifies two automatic Snakemake workflows: data collection and preprocessing, followed by model building and solving. Zenodo supplies one ZIP archive freely under CC BY 4.0. The record represents this concrete archived implementation, while the related REMix framework describes the wider energy-system optimisation machinery. Coverage, scenario years, input sources, geographical resolution and detailed output variables are not specified in the inspected description. Those gaps prevent claims about operational deployment or a completed particular regional analysis. The source refers to a contained README for further information, which was not downloaded. The code was not executed and workflow dependencies, numerical results and current compatibility remain unverified.
